lastCompletedStory.title: Fail-closed maxBuffer fix for readBacklogFromMain batch read

nextStoryContext: readBacklogFromMain (src/issues/backlog.ts) is now fail-closed: BacklogSpawnFn options carry an optional maxBuffer, the cat-file --batch spawn passes maxBuffer: 256*1024*1024, and a populated catResult.error or non-zero catResult.status throws instead of silently parsing a truncated buffer. This is a real behavior change for every caller of readBacklogFromMain/allocateId: CLI entry points (cam issue list, issue-specify, triage, plan, issue-file) now propagate a thrown error on a real git failure instead of silently getting an empty/partial backlog -- this is intentional (matches the story's fail-closed intent) but any NEW call site added inside a long-lived best-effort loop tick (like the sidecar) MUST wrap the call in its own try/catch, mirroring the fix already applied to sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker in src/commands/sidecar.ts. Regression tests live in test/issues/backlog.test.ts: a real on-disk git tmpdir test (skipIf no git) proving a >1MiB cat-file --batch stdout is read in full including the highest id, plus injected-fake tests proving both error and non-zero-status batch reads throw. Had to raise the src/commands/sidecar.ts file-size ceiling 2941->2951 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (the try/catch guard + updated docstring added 10 lines); staged with the story diff and the _ref note is prepended.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed spawnSync's maxBuffer option is byte-denominated with a 1 MiB (1024*1024) default; exceeding it truncates stdout, terminates the child, and sets a populated .error alongside .status. Our 256*1024*1024 override plus the catResult.error / non-zero catResult.status throw-guard matches this documented contract exactly.
